description: Source code for KafkaOffsetRangeCalculator class and related components, used for calculating Kafka offset ranges in Spark Kafka integration.

classes.name: KafkaOffsetRangeCalculator
classes.description: Class to calculate offset ranges to process based on the from and until offsets, and the configured minPartitions and maxRecordsPerPartition.

classes.name: KafkaOffsetRange
classes.description: Case class representing a range of Kafka offsets for a specific topic partition.

methods.name: getRanges
methods.description: Calculates the Kafka offset ranges to process based on input ranges, minPartitions, maxRecordsPerPartition, and executor locations.

methods.name: getDividedPartition
methods.description: Divides a KafkaOffsetRange into multiple ranges based on the number of parts.

methods.name: getPartCount
methods.description: Determines the number of parts to divide a range into, based on size, total size, and minimum parts.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Determines preferred executor location for a given topic partition.
